Publisher record https://www.impan.pl/en/publishing-house/journals-and-series/acta-arithmetica/all/42/22/103738/applications-of-jacobi-s-symbol-to-lehmer-s-numbers ; observed archive URL https://matwbn.icm.edu.pl/ksiazki/aa/aa42/aa4224.pdf . 2. Inspect Rotkiewicz, Problems on Fibonacci numbers and their generalizations, in Fibonacci numbers and their applications (Patras,1984), Math. Appl.28 (1986), 241-255, Granville reference 6.
3. Follow the most relevant subsequent citations for first Lehmer parameters (L,M)=(8,-1), associated parameters (R,Q)=(12,1), primitive cyclotomic factors, and their quadratic characters at Mersenne primes. Use original papers, author manuscripts, and publisher records as authorities, not generated summaries or titles alone. This is a bounded review: prioritize exact subsumption over collecting distant references.

Important notation: lambda=sqrt(3)+sqrt(2). For odd n our U_n=(lambda^n+lambda^(-n))/(2sqrt(3))=1,9,89,881,8721,... . It is first Lehmer P_n with roots lambda,-lambda^-1 and (L,M)=(8,-1), AND associated Lehmer V_n with roots lambda,lambda^-1 and (R,Q)=(12,1). These descriptions concern odd terms. For odd source e>1, N_e=Norm_Ke(C_e^2+8)=prod_(d|e) U_d^mu(e/d)=Phi_e(lambda,-lambda^-1)=Phi_(2e)(lambda,lambda^-1). It is a primitive factor, not generally U_e. Ordinary Lucas recurrence x_(n+2)=10x_(n+1)-x_n gives U_n*W_n at odd n, not U_n alone. Bumby's 1967 theorem already handles whole square U_n and prime-source N_p; that ingredient is known. A primitive divisor without odd valuation does not prove N_e nonsquare.

Exact criterion to compare: ell=2^t-1 prime, odd t>=3, w(p)=2^(v2(p^2-1)-3) for distinct odd primes p dividing e. If sum w(p)=2^(t-2), then Legendre(N_e/ell)=-1 for EVERY positive exponent vector. Its separate geometric application excludes sqrt(C_e^2+8) from every cyclotomic field. Finite differences and the Lucas-Lehmer finite-field mechanism have standard precedents. Determine whether the exact arithmetic statement or a stronger published theorem implies it; independently assess whether the cyclotomic/geometric application was found previously.

Deliver a concise plain-English conclusion first, then a concrete source-by-source technical comparison with links, bibliographic details, page/theorem numbers, checked assumptions, and explicit scope of inspection. Label each claim known / follows from a cited theorem / no direct match among inspected sources / unresolved. If a stronger theorem settles the general target-three norm claim, give the precise derivation and exceptional cases. If sources remain inaccessible, say exactly which and what remains unchecked; do not guess or claim novelty from a negative search. Include ready-to-use replacement text for the unresolved-leads/conclusion sections of LITERATURE_REVIEW132.md and suggested bibliography additions. Do not claim scripts were executed.
